'''K6P-3''', or '''Kaysixpee''', was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] used as a messenger to recruit allies to [[Mission to Athiss|combat]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] threat that arose from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K6P-3 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Republic Flashpoint courier for the flashpoint "Athiss".<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
